title: Pox
extract:
The Pox are a thrown  Infested weapon that, similar to the  Torid, releases a  Toxin cloud upon coming into contact with a surface or enemy, making it ideal for large groups or area denial. However, its low magazine size and ammunition reserves mean that players must be mindful of their ammo.

Characteristics
This weapon deals  Toxin damage.
Spores explode in a 2.5 meter radius upon impact with a surface or enemy, lingering for 4 seconds while dealing continuous  Toxin damage.
Initial hit and spore cloud apply status separately.
Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls.
Does not inflict self-stagger.
No Damage Falloff.
Can benefit from  Fulmination ( Primed).
Cannot use thrown-exclusive mod  Concealed Explosives.

Acquisition
The Pox's blueprint can be researched from the Bio Lab in the dojo.

Tips
As the Pox explode on contact with surfaces instead of sticking to them, adding  Heat or  Electricity damage is recommended to keep enemies in the clouds for extended periods.
The high status chance of the Pox, along with its innate  Toxin damage makes it an effective tool to reduce enemy armor via  Corrosive procs or amp other attacks with  Viral procs.
This weapon performs especially well in corridors and cramped spaces where enemies are forced to cluster together, and the stacked gas clouds can make short work of them.
Pox users should be mindful about their ammo reserves when using this tactic, however, because they might find themselves ganged up by enemies while trying to pick up ammo drops.

Trivia
Pox refers to a type of disease that is characterized by pustules or pockmarks that cover the whole body, examples of which include Chickenpox and Smallpox.
In earlier times, Pox may be used to refer to diseases in general, or a curse.
